# Phase 1 — UI Design Contract

> Visual and interaction contract for frontend phases. Generated by gsd-ui-researcher, verified by gsd-ui-checker.

---

## Scope Note

Phase 1 is the multi-tenant foundation phase. Per `01-CONTEXT.md`, its UI surface is **owner-facing account/venue chrome + staff tablet authentication chrome only** — no menu/category/item CRUD, no diner-facing surface, no theming (that's Phase 4). Two distinct interaction contexts exist and are treated separately below:

1. **Owner surface** — conventional B2B SaaS admin UI, used on the owner's own phone/laptop. Signup, login, venue onboarding, staff list, device registry, venue settings.
2. **Tablet ("staff mode") surface** — a shared, in-restaurant kiosk-style device. Name-grid → PIN pad, POS-referenced (Toast/Square). Large touch targets, unattended-device assumptions.

Both surfaces use the same design system (below); the tablet surface additionally carries the 44px touch-target exception noted in Spacing.

## Design System

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Tool | shadcn (recommended — not yet initialized; project is greenfield, no `package.json`/`components.json` exist yet) |
| Preset | Not yet generated. Initialize during Wave 1 scaffold (`01-01-PLAN.md`, after `create-next-app`) with: **style = new-york, base color = neutral, CSS variables = true**. Rationale: this is Cena's own internal product chrome (owner dashboard + tablet), not the diner-facing brandable surface — neutral/professional is the correct default until Phase 4 introduces per-venue branding to the *diner* menu only. Do not use Phase 4's future brand tokens here. |
| Component library | Radix primitives (via shadcn) |
| Icon library | `lucide-react` (shadcn default) |
| Font | Inter (system default via `next/font/google`, `font-sans`) — clean, high legibility for forms and PIN digits; no brand font decision applies to this phase |

**Components needed this phase** (install via `npx shadcn add ...` during Wave 1/relevant wave, not all at once): `button`, `input`, `label`, `card`, `dialog`, `dropdown-menu`, `form`, `table`, `avatar`, `badge`, `alert`, `separator`, `sonner` (toast), `checkbox` (Terms consent, D-21).

**Note for executor:** shadcn initialization is a Wave 1 scaffold task, not a design decision deferred to later — it must happen before any owner-facing page is built, so every subsequent phase inherits the same primitives.

## Spacing Scale

Declared values (must be multiples of 4):

| Token | Value | Usage |
|-------|-------|-------|
| xs | 4px | Icon gaps, inline padding |
| sm | 8px | Compact element spacing (form field gaps, badge padding) |
| md | 16px | Default element spacing (card padding, form row spacing) |
| lg | 24px | Section padding (dashboard section gaps) |
| xl | 32px | Layout gaps (page margins on desktop) |
| 2xl | 48px | Major section breaks (onboarding step transitions) |
| 3xl | 64px | Page-level spacing (tablet PIN-pad vertical centering) |

**Exceptions:**
- **Tablet name-grid tiles and PIN pad keys: minimum 44px×44px touch target**, with 8px gaps between keys/tiles. This is a hard floor, not a default — the tablet is touched by staff mid-service, often with wet/gloved hands; anything smaller than 44px is a release-blocking usability defect for this surface.
- **PIN dot indicators** (the 4 filled/unfilled circles showing PIN entry progress): 12px diameter, 8px gaps — these are display-only, not touch targets, so they're exempt from the 44px floor.

---

## Typography

| Role | Size | Weight | Line Height |
|------|------|--------|-------------|
| Body | 16px | 400 (regular) | 1.5 |
| Label | 14px | 600 (semibold) | 1.4 |
| Heading | 20px | 600 (semibold) | 1.2 |
| Display | 28px | 600 (semibold) | 1.2 |

Only two weights used across the whole phase: 400 (regular, body copy) and 600 (semibold, everything else — labels, headings, display, button text). Never introduce a third weight.

**Tablet-specific note:** the PIN pad's numeral keys render at Display size (28px) or larger at implementation time for tap-target legibility from arm's length — this is a floor, not a ceiling; the executor may size PIN pad digits larger than 28px if the 44px touch-target requirement demands it, but must not drop below the declared 4-size system for any other tablet text (name-grid labels use Label/Body sizes as normal).

---

## Color

| Role | Value | Usage |
|------|-------|-------|
| Dominant (60%) | `#FFFFFF` | Page background, card surfaces, form backgrounds |
| Secondary (30%) | `#F4F4F5` (zinc-100) | Sidebar/nav background, table row stripes, staff name-grid tile background, disabled states |
| Accent (10%) | `#16A34A` (green-600) | See "Accent reserved for" below — deliberately narrow |
| Destructive | `#DC2626` (red-600) | Destructive actions only — see below |

**Accent reserved for:**
- Primary CTA buttons: "Create your account", "Create venue", "Add staff member", "Enable staff mode", "Invite staff"
- The active/selected nav item in the owner dashboard sidebar
- The PIN pad key's pressed/active state (momentary, on tap)
- Focus ring on primary inputs (email, PIN field) — standard focus-visible outline

**Accent is NOT used for:** icons in general, links in body text, secondary/tertiary buttons, badges (badges use neutral or semantic colors per state, not brand accent), the "Revoke"/"Deactivate" buttons (those are destructive red, never accent green).

**Destructive reserved for:**
- "Revoke device" button + its confirmation dialog
- "Deactivate staff member" button + its confirmation dialog
- Inline error/validation text and error alert banners (signup/login/venue-creation failures)
- Wrong-PIN feedback state on the tablet

## Copywriting Contract

This phase has several distinct flows; each needs its own primary CTA. All rows below are prescriptive, not illustrative.

| Element | Copy |
|---------|------|
| Primary CTA — signup | "Create your account" |
| Primary CTA — venue creation (final onboarding step) | "Create venue" |
| Primary CTA — invite/provision staff | "Add staff member" |
| Primary CTA — enable staff mode (tablet) | "Enable staff mode" |
| Empty state — staff list | Heading: **"No staff yet"** — Body: "Add your first staff member so they can start toggling item availability from the floor." — CTA: "Add staff member" |
| Empty state — device registry | Heading: **"No devices enrolled"** — Body: "Enable staff mode on a tablet in your restaurant to get started." — CTA: "Enable staff mode" |
| Error state — signup/login | "That email or password isn't right. Check and try again, or reset your password." |
| Error state — venue creation | "Something went wrong creating your venue. Check the details and try again." |
| Error state — PIN entry (first failures) | "Wrong PIN. Try again." |
| Error state — PIN entry (after repeated failures, D-18 backoff) | "Too many attempts. Try again in {N}s." (countdown, exact curve is planner/executor discretion per CONTEXT.md) |
| Error state — generic/network | "Something went wrong. Please try again." |
| Destructive confirmation — revoke device (D-08) | "Revoke this device?" — "Staff on this tablet will be signed out immediately and won't be able to toggle availability until re-enabled." — Confirm button: "Revoke device" |
| Destructive confirmation — deactivate staff (D-20) | "Deactivate {name}?" — "Their PIN will stop working immediately. This can't be undone, but their past activity stays on record." — Confirm button: "Deactivate" |
| Consent capture (D-21) | Checkbox label: "I agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy" (both as links) — required, unchecked by default, blocks signup submit until checked |
| Multi-venue switcher (D-15, only shown when 2+ venues) | No label text needed beyond the venue name itself in a dropdown; each entry shows venue name + currency badge (e.g. "Bistro Central · RON") |

## UI Considerations

Engine-verified state coverage (ui-consideration-probe, post-checker-approval run). 11 elements classified; 65 applicable considerations raised: **49 covered, 4 backstop, 12 dismissed (with reasons), 0 unresolved.** Empty-state and error-state COPY lives in `## Copywriting Contract` — rows below reference it rather than restating it.

Element kinds confirmed (auto mode — detected kinds plus authored additions): E9 name-grid is both `list-collection` and `interactive-control` (adds tile-name long-text); E10 PIN pad is both `interactive-control` and `form` (adds loading/error/partial — PIN verification is a submit); E11 toasts authored as `static-content` (heuristic returned unclassified).

### E1 — Signup form (form)

| Category | Status | Resolution / Reason |
|----------|--------|---------------------|
| empty | ✅ covered | Default state is the unfilled form: all fields with labels, consent checkbox unchecked by default (D-21); submit blocked until required fields + consent are valid |
| loading | ✅ covered | Submit button shows inline spinner and disables during the Server Action round-trip; no full-page overlay |
| error | ✅ covered | Inline Zod field-level errors + top-level error alert banner (see Copywriting Contract, signup/login error row) |
| partial | ✅ covered | Partially completed submit → Zod surfaces inline errors on exactly the missing/invalid fields; entered values are preserved |
| long-text | ✅ covered | Long input values scroll natively within the field; validation copy wraps to multiple lines, never truncates |

### E2 — Login form (form)

| Category | Status | Resolution / Reason |
|----------|--------|---------------------|
| empty | ✅ covered | Unfilled two-field form is the designed default state |
| loading | ✅ covered | Same submit-button spinner + disable pattern as E1 |
| error | ✅ covered | Copywriting Contract signup/login error row |
| partial | ✅ covered | Zod per-field inline errors; entered values preserved |
| overflow | ✖ dismissed | Fixed two-field card fits every supported viewport; no scrollable content region exists |
| long-text | ✅ covered | Input values scroll natively; error copy wraps |

### E3 — Venue creation form (form)

| Category | Status | Resolution / Reason |
|----------|--------|---------------------|
| empty | ✅ covered | Unfilled final onboarding step; fields with labels |
| loading | ✅ covered | Submit spinner + disable during Server Action round-trip |
| error | ✅ covered | Copywriting Contract venue-creation error row |
| partial | ✅ covered | Zod inline errors; values preserved within the onboarding step |
| long-text | ✅ covered | No max-length enforced on venue name at input; the field scrolls natively — display-side truncation is the E4/E5 backstop |

### E4 — Dashboard sidebar nav + header (nav; heuristic also matched list-collection — inapplicable categories dismissed)

| Category | Status | Resolution / Reason |
|----------|--------|---------------------|
| empty | ✖ dismissed | Nav items are a fixed set of static routes, not data-driven; a zero-item state cannot occur |
| loading | ✖ dismissed | Nav ships in the server-rendered dashboard shell (RSC payload); it never loads asynchronously on its own |
| error | ✖ dismissed | No independent client fetch — nav cannot fail separately from the page; page failures are the route error boundary's concern |
| populated | ✖ dismissed | Fixed nav items; no variable-volume populated state |
| partial | ✖ dismissed | Nav rows have no optional data fields |
| overflow | ✅ covered | On short viewports the sidebar scrolls vertically; nav items never clip |
| zero-one-many | ✖ dismissed | Item count is fixed at build time |
| long-text | 🧪 backstop | { statement: "Venue name in the dashboard header truncates with ellipsis beyond ~28 characters; no input-time max-length", verification: backstop } — held-out visual check at verify time |

### E5 — Multi-venue switcher (list-collection + nav)

| Category | Status | Resolution / Reason |
|----------|--------|---------------------|
| empty | ✖ dismissed | Owner always has ≥1 venue post-onboarding, and the switcher is hidden entirely below 2 venues (D-15) — a zero-venue switcher state is unreachable |
| loading | ✖ dismissed | Venue list ships in the server-rendered shell; the dropdown opens on already-present data |
| error | ✖ dismissed | No independent fetch to fail |
| populated | ✅ covered | Dropdown lists all venues; each row shows venue name + currency badge ("Bistro Central · RON") |
| partial | ✖ dismissed | Name and currency are both required at venue creation; a partial row cannot exist |
| overflow | ✅ covered | Dropdown content scrolls internally beyond ~8 entries (shadcn dropdown-menu max-height); never grows past the viewport |
| zero-one-many | ✅ covered | 1 venue → switcher hidden entirely (D-15); 2+ venues → dropdown |
| long-text | 🧪 backstop | { statement: "Venue name in switcher rows truncates with ellipsis beyond ~28 characters", verification: backstop } — same held-out visual check as E4 |

### E6 — Staff list (list-collection)

| Category | Status | Resolution / Reason |
|----------|--------|---------------------|
| empty | ✅ covered | "No staff yet" empty state (see Copywriting Contract) |
| loading | ✅ covered | List arrives in the server-rendered page payload — no client-side fetch, so no in-page skeleton; route-level loading UI is planner discretion |
| error | ✅ covered | Page-level query failure surfaces the route error boundary with the generic error copy row |
| populated | ✅ covered | Table rows: name, avatar, status badge |
| partial | ✅ covered | Missing avatar → initials fallback (shadcn avatar default); deactivated staff stay listed with a muted badge (audit history preserved, D-20) |
| overflow | 🧪 backstop | { statement: "Scrollable list beyond viewport height; no pagination or search in v1 — acceptable at expected venue staff counts", verification: backstop } — not verified against a large-N fixture |
| zero-one-many | ✅ covered | Zero → empty state; one and many render the same table layout, no special-casing |
| long-text | ✅ covered | Names truncate with ellipsis at row width; full name on hover tooltip |

| Category | Status | Resolution / Reason |
|----------|--------|---------------------|
| empty | ✅ covered | "No devices enrolled" empty state (see Copywriting Contract) |
| loading | ✅ covered | Server-rendered payload, same pattern as staff list |
| error | ✅ covered | Route error boundary + generic error copy row |
| populated | ✅ covered | Device rows with label, enrolled date, status badge, and destructive "Revoke device" button on active rows |
